purpose: Define the neutral Java snapshot envelope for Python QueryModel aggregate join implementation and governance replay.

requiredCases.description: One left row with multiple RHS details keeps the left measure at the original grain and exposes RHS aggregate outputs.
SQLite generated SQL renders a structured RHS derived aggregate relation before LEFT JOIN.
RHS groupBy missing a right join key fails closed.
Fixed RHS relation filter is rendered inside the aggregate relation before GROUP BY.
Runtime extData value is rendered as an RHS derived-relation parameter.
Missing runtime extData value fails closed.
Safe AND join-key/group-key/measure predicates duplicate to RHS WHERE/HAVING and emit pushed diagnostics.
OR or mixed complex predicates remain outer-only and emit retained diagnostics.
Denying the RHS source physical column rejects aggregate outputs and dependent calculated fields.
Aggregate output projection passes when fieldAccess allows the selected output aliases.
Denying a selected aggregate output alias fails closed with sanitized markers.
System slice governance can filter on an aggregate output without projecting or exposing that guard field.
A denied RHS source physical column that is unrelated to selected aggregate outputs does not block the query.
A dynamic calculated field depending on a denied aggregate source fails closed.
A transitive calculated dependency on a denied aggregate source fails closed.
A predefined calculated field depending on a denied aggregate source fails closed.
A predefined calculated field over allowed aggregate relation data renders and returns stable output evidence.
A raw SQL accessBuilder predicate stays outside the RHS aggregate subquery.
Ordering by an aggregate relation output renders against the outer aggregate alias instead of the RHS source column.
returnTotal keeps aggregate relation SQL and exposes a matching totalData envelope.
IS NULL on a nullable aggregate relation output remains outer-only and records retained diagnostics.
IS NOT NULL on a nullable aggregate relation output remains outer-only and records retained diagnostics.
Semantic V3 debug.extra exposes aggregate relation diagnostics with pushed WHERE/HAVING decisions.
Composite join keys duplicate safe key predicates into RHS WHERE and aggregate output predicates into HAVING.
Structured accessBuilder field-reference predicates are parameterized and pushed into the RHS aggregate relation.
Unsafe runtime filter text fails closed and does not leak the rejected raw value.
Aggregate relation can join on a left dimension business key while unrelated request predicates remain outside RHS pushdown.
RHS fixed filters can traverse a dimension join inside the aggregate relation derived query.
V3 metadata exposes aggregateRelation lineage and inherited aggregation/source metadata.

plannedPythonReplay.implementationBoundary: Replay Java neutral fixture cases before expanding Python production aggregate join behavior beyond the current guarded SQLite boundary.
